# PAC helper asset

`pac_js_library.h` is the unmodified Chromium `services/proxy_resolver/pac_js_library.h` from the locally available Qt WebEngine source archive. It contains Mozilla PAC standard date/time/domain helpers and the Microsoft `isResolvableEx` wrapper; the host supplies private worker-local DNS functions. The original copyright and MPL 1.1 / GPL 2-or-later / LGPL 2.1-or-later choice remain in the file, compatible with the host GPL-3.0-only distribution via its GPL 2-or-later alternative. Chromium BSD notice is retained in `CHROMIUM-LICENSE`. No V8, Electron, Node or DOM runtime is imported.

Source: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/services/proxy_resolver/pac_js_library.h

Imported 2026-10-15, SHA-256: `055f001143749cf935610e18f4b4f489aadb6ca124a68e9f3e45cf7a933a3a95`. This is a pinned source asset; do not run the host formatter on it. Source/asset/license compatibility is recorded here; platform PAC acceptance is tracked separately.
